pr_comments: @petebacondarwin could you please have a look at this change when you get a chance?

Hi @iRealNirmal - rather than add a new example, I think what we ought to do is actually change the current guide, removing the references to `waitForAsync` from this section and updating the example. See https://angular.io/guide/testing-components-scenarios#compilecomponents-is-async

You can preview 9a1c5f8 at https://pr41947-9a1c5f8.ngbuilds.io/.
You can preview 2deb41c at https://pr41947-2deb41c.ngbuilds.io/.
You can preview 858d897 at https://pr41947-858d897.ngbuilds.io/.

This is looking great! I added the preview label so that you can see what it looks like in the actual docs. https://pr41947-858d897.ngbuilds.io/guide/testing-components-scenarios#calling-compilecomponents I note the following: I think this whole bit should be removed altogether. Also the import of `waitForAsync` should be removed from the example.
Further I see that in https://pr41947-858d897.ngbuilds.io/guide/testing-components-scenarios#consolidated-setup it once again mentions `waitForAsync`. This should also be updated to this new format.
You can preview c7c5b95 at https://pr41947-c7c5b95.ngbuilds.io/.

> Looking good. A few NITs and then we are done.

Thanks took care of it.

Hello @iRealNirmal,

This conflicts with the 11.2.x branch. Since it's a docs change, I think it's fine to merge it into the 12.x docs only. If you really really want to land this in 11.2.x, feel free to open a separate PR against that branch specifically. I don't think that's necessary, though.

Cheers,
Alex

issue_context.title: TestBed beforeEach docs aren't coherent with CLI Generate
comments: @petebacondarwin do you suggest document update here ?

@iRealNirmal  -  I think we could update the docs to match the CLI. But @alan-agius4 and I think we could probably also consolidate the two `beforeEach` blocks in new projects...

Also I just want to check with the FW team that we do actually want to use `async () => {...}` here rather than `waitForAsync(() => { ... })`, since they have slightly different semantics

so  @petebacondarwin before updating document you want code modified and consolidate beforeEach block as well right ? Sorry following up here as thinking this can be two different PR or we want to cover all this under one PR only.

I discussed this with the team.

The decision is to update the docs to match exactly what the CLI generates. This provides consistency.

While the two `beforeEach` blocks could be consolidated into one, it doesn't really matter, and since the guide currently suggests having two, we should leave it as-is for now.
thanks @petebacondarwin let me work on updating this document related PR

Maybe my question is dumb but I'll go for it: What's the purpose of waitForAsync now that Javascript's async exists (except retro-compatibly) ? 

It could be deprecated then removed in the future no ? Since it's an old helper for testing when async didn't exist if I understood correctly.
I see! Thanks for your explanation, I've actually been in this kind of cases before but I always found a way around using done() or rxjs, but I see why this can't be removed.
